Final for Publication

Type-1 Zoning Map Amendment at
3401 North Lawndale Avenue

Substitute Narrative From RS-3 to RS-3

1.A. The applicant and owner of the property further identified as Parcel#! listed
below, Catholic Bishop of Chicago an Illinois Corporation sole on behalf of
Saints Viator and Wenceslaus Parish, is seeking approval of a Type-l Map
Amendment from a RS-3 Residential Single-Unit (Detached House) District to
that of a RS-3 Residential Single-Unit (Detached House) District in order to allow
the establishment of two improved zoning lots.

The applicant wishes to clarify that the previously submitted application included
two proposed driveway facilities on Lawndale Avenue. These driveways were
added in error and have been removed from the current proposal. This substitute
narrative is provided to document the correction and ensure the application
accurately reflects the intended redevelopment plan for 3401 North Lawndale
Avenue.

Subject lot is improved with three existing improvements:
e Achurch addressed at 3401 N. Lawndale Ave. (Parcel# 1)
e A rectory addressed 3400 N. Monticello Ave. (Parcel# /)
e A school building addressed at 3425 N. Lawndale Ave. (Parcel#2)
- all three improvements are to remain.

Subject is two of three existing improvements located on this 86,483.79 sq. ft.
improved lot. The proposed division of this lot into two separate parcels will
result in Parcel#1, containing the existing church and rectory. yielding a square
footage of 53,692.0 and Parcel#2, improved with an existing school building, will
contain 32,791.79 sq. ft. of total lot size.

The Catholic Bishop of Chicago intends to retain the existing church and
accessory rectory with attached garage. along with 54 off street parking spaces,
pending approval of proposed zoning amendment.

The purchaser of Parcel#2, 3425 Lawndale Apartments. LLC. is proposing to
redevelop the existing 42.104.0 sq. ft. three-story school building. located on the
west end of the improved zoning lot. into a 28 dwelling-unit residential building
with 24 vehicular off-street parking spaces (one of which to be ADA accessible)
with access via two existing driveway facilities located on N. Monticello Avenue.
Proposal also includes 18 indoor bicycle spaces. The proposed redevelopment of
the school building is solely based on approval of proposed Type-! Map
Amendment Application.

In order to bring the existing church and rectory into compliance, the Applicant is

proposing to amend the current zoning classification of Parcel#1 from RS-3 to
RS-3 for the existing church and accessory rectory buildings with attached garage
